verdict.rationale: Datalab documents schema-based structured extraction with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability. That is an adjacent traceability feature. Nothing in the pack shows per-field confidence scores, calibration, or a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields
